verses.1: After Moses, the servant of the Lord, died, the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses' servant, saying:
verses.2: "Moses, my servant, has died. Now, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land I am giving to them, to the Israelites.
verses.3: Every place where your feet step will be yours, just as I promised Moses.
verses.4: From the wilderness and this Lebanon to the great river, the Euphrates, and to the Great Sea, the rising of the sun—this shall be your boundary.
verses.5: No one will stand against you all the days of your life, just as I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not abandon you or forsake you.
verses.6: Be strong and courageous, for you will give this people their inheritance, the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.
verses.7: Only be strong and very courageous, to keep and do all the teaching that Moses, my servant, commanded you. Do not turn from it, neither to the right nor to the left, so that you may succeed in all you do.
verses.8: Let this book of teaching not depart from your mouth. Meditate in it day and night, so that you may keep and do all that is written in it. Then you will succeed in your way and will prosper.
verses.9: Have I not commanded you: Be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go.
verses.10: Joshua then commanded the officers of the people, saying:
verses.11: "Go through the camp and command the people, saying, Prepare for the journey, for in three days you will cross this Jordan to possess the land the Lord your God is giving you to possess."
verses.12: To the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said:
verses.13: "Remember the word that Moses, the servant of the Lord, commanded you, saying, 'The Lord your God has given you rest and this land.'
verses.14: Your wives, your children, and your livestock may dwell in the land that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan. But you, cross over armed before your brothers, every strong and able man, to assist them.
verses.15: Until the Lord your God has given rest to your brothers as to you, and they too have taken possession of the land the Lord your God is giving them. Then you will return to the land your inheritance, which Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave you beyond the Jordan east of the sun.
verses.16: The people answered Joshua, saying, "Everything you command us we will do, and to any place you send us we will go.
verses.17: Just as we listened to Moses, so we will listen to you. Only may the Lord your God be with you, as He was with Moses."
verses.18: "Every man who rebels against your word and does not listen to your commands, no matter what you order, shall be put to death. Only be strong and courageous."

notes:
Notes  
- v. 4: "the rising of the sun" is a literal rendering of מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ, a common expression for the east.  
- v. 8: "Meditate in it" reflects the Hebrew לְהָגִיתָ, often translated as "meditate," but here placed in context to reflect its spiritual and habitual nature.

[16] The people answered Joshua, saying, "Everything you command us we will do, and to any place you send us we will go.

Notes  
- v. 4: "the rising of the sun" is a literal rendering of מִזְרַח הַשָּׁמֶשׁ, a common expression for the east.
